newsitem.title: USA: Optical Coating gets favorable ruling.
newsitem.headline: Optical Coating gets favorable ruling.

text.p: Optical Coating Laboratory Inc said Tuesday it had received a favorable ruling in a lawsuit against the company by SICPA Holding SA seeking to prevent an initial public offering by an Optical Coating subsidiary.

It said the Delaware Court of Chancery upheld the positions of Optical Coating and its 60 percent-owned subsidiary Flex Products Inc that a simple majority of the Flex board has the legal authority to authorize a public offering.

SICPA, which owns 40 percent of Flex, had contended that Flex could not move ahead with an initial public offering without SICPA's consent. SICPA also maintained it had a right to purchase Optical Coating's ownership of Flex because it holds a call option.
Optical Coating said the court's decision did not address the specific requirements of any future public offering by Flex.
"With the court's decision, it would appear that the way is cleared for Flex to take the next steps to raise the capital necessary to provide for its continued growth," Optical Coating said.
Optical Coating manufactures optical thin film coated components. Flex designs and manufactures thin film coatings on flexible subtrates.
